name: Nhlamulo Baloyi
text:
I joined AFT in May 2025 and the experience was exceptional. The classes were well structured, and the mock exams were thoroughly marked with valuable personal feedback. The preparation was outstanding and played a huge role in helping me score above 100 in my first attempt at MCS.
A big thank you to Patrick and the entire AFT team for their dedication, support, and commitment to excellence. Highly recommended!

name: Tariro Leandrah Mabvira
text: I can’t recommend Accountants For Tomorrow highly enough. Thanks to their structured approach, expert tutors, and excellent study materials, I was able to pass all my CIMA exams. The tutors explained complex topics clearly and always related them to real-world scenarios, which made a huge difference. Their support and guidance kept me motivated throughout the journey. An outstanding provider for anyone serious about succeeding in CIMA.

name: Blessed Masunika
text: Just the right content preparing you for what is to come. They guide you every step of the journey. I totally recommend their services!

name: Preston Chetty
text: I will recommend AFT to anyone who is on their Cima journey. They helped me pass my management case study on the first try.

name: Samukelisiwe Fortunate Khumalo
text: I love how Patrick was always full of energy. No matter how tired I was after work, his energy was contagious. AFT is like home.

name: Anele April
text: I would highly recommend AFT they played a crucial role in my CIMA journey. After my long break from studying their support and dedication made a great difference. The classes were engaging and well structured and the tutors and lectures are always available to help whenever needed. Their study materials and mocks exams are also incredible useful. Once again Thanks I was able to pass successfully 🙌🏽

name: Litshani Mulaudzi
text:
Agh man, AFT has to be theeee best team to date. Ive attempted to complete the Management level for two years and they were able to help me complete it in 4 months!!!!! The continuous support and prompt response came in handy for someone balancing school and work.

Give them a try, best decision ever!!
